results.title: East China refunds: public-safe summary for interns
results.content: Refund requests in East China rose noticeably in September, while other regions stayed in their normal range (b-101, b-103). Many of the related customer complaints were about checkout and payment problems, such as being charged twice or charged after a failed payment (b-207). The cause is still under investigation and has not been confirmed. Customers can request a refund within 30 days from the Orders page, and it is returned to the original payment method within 5-7 business days (b-208). Exact rates, ticket shares and unconfirmed release-related details from b-101, b-207 and b-318 are left out because those blocks are not public; b-318 is also unverified.
